items.title: Practicum Assistant of Statistical Data Analysis
items.description: Assisted lecturers in facilitating practical sessions on statistical data analysis
achievements: Led practicum sessions on descriptive statistics, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression, time series analysis, and ANOVA for undergraduate students.
Guided students in using statistical software to analyze data, read statistical results, and draw clear conclusions from the analysis.
Designed practical exercises and discussion sessions to help students solve statistical problems and apply data analysis methods to real cases.
Reviewed analytical reports and assignments, providing feedback to improve students’ accuracy, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

items.title: Practicum Assistant of Sampling Method
items.description: Assisted lecturers in facilitating practical sessions on sampling method.
achievements: Led practicum sessions on sampling techniques, including probability sampling, non-probability sampling, and sample size determination.
Guided students in selecting suitable sampling methods and applying statistical software to analyze sample data.
Developed practical exercises that helped students understand how sampling methods affect data quality and analysis results.
Reviewed assignments and provided feedback on sampling methods, data analysis, and interpretation of results.

items.title: Assistant Lecturer of Multivariable Calculus
items.description: Assisted lecturers in delivering Multivariable Calculus courses and supporting classroom activities.
achievements: Supported lectures and tutorial sessions covering limits, infinite series, Riemann integrals, and single and multiple integrals.
Guided students through complex mathematical problems using clear and structured problem-solving approaches.
Led practice sessions that strengthened students’ mathematical reasoning, analytical thinking, and quantitative skills.
Reviewed assignments and assessed students’ progress to provide feedback and identify areas for improvement.

items.title: Assistant Lecturer of General Insurance
items.description: Assisted lecturers in delivering General Insurance courses and supporting classroom activities.
achievements: Guided students in understanding general insurance and actuarial concepts, including premium calculation, reserves, and insurance risk assessment.
Explained actuarial methods and helped students apply them to insurance problems and practical case studies.
Developed learning materials, practice questions, and case studies to connect actuarial theory with real insurance applications.
Reviewed assignments and provided feedback to improve students’ accuracy in actuarial calculations and understanding of insurance concepts.

items.title: Practicum Assistant of Accounting
items.description: Assisted lecturers in facilitating practical sessions on Accounting.
achievements: Led practicum sessions covering general journals, ledgers, adjusting journal entries, and closing journal entries.
Guided students in applying accounting concepts to practical cases and recording financial transactions accurately.
Reviewed students work to identify errors and provided feedback to improve their understanding and accuracy.
Coordinated practicum activities and supported students throughout practical exercises to ensure effective learning.

items.title: Practicum Assistant of Introduction to Computer and Software II
items.description: Assisted lecturers in facilitating practical sessions on Introduction to Computer & Software.
achievements: Guided students in using Flowgorithm and C++ to understand basic programming concepts and develop simple solutions.
Led practical exercises that trained students to break down problems into logical steps and algorithms.
Supervised practicum sessions and helped students solve programming problems during hands-on activities.
Reviewed programming assignments and supported lecturers in evaluating students’ understanding of programming and algorithm concepts.
